author: Corridor Crew
description:
This crazy short film, The Wizard of Speed and Time, was made in 1979 by Mike Jittlov as a solo project to showcase his craft. One could say he succeeded at this, as shortly after its release, he was hired as a Disney animator.

What makes it even more impressive is that everything in it was achieved either through in-camera tricks or edits made directly on the physical film.
Have you seen it? If not, you can easily find it on YouTube!
title: How did HE do THIS in 1979?!
